# plot_representative_sample_subplots { #mofography.data.plot_representative_sample_subplots }

```python
data.plot_representative_sample_subplots(
    full,
    sample,
    strat_cols=None,
    nbins_hist=40,
    n_sample=None,
    title=None,
)
```

Build a 2x2 Plotly figure comparing full vs sample histograms for each
stratification column (surface area, void fraction, LCD, PLD). Use to verify
that a representative sample matches the full distribution.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                                                              | Default    |
|------------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| full       |        | Full population DataFrame (MOFdb-style columns).                         | _required_ |
| sample     |        | Sampled DataFrame from sample_representative_mofdb.                      | _required_ |
| strat_cols |        | Columns to plot; defaults to MOFDB_STRAT_COLS.                           | `None`     |
| nbins_hist |        | Number of histogram bins per subplot.                                    | `40`       |
| n_sample   |        | Number to show in title (default: len(sample)).                          | `None`     |
| title      |        | Main figure title. If None, uses "Representative subset (N={n_sample})". | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description    |
|--------|--------|----------------|
|        |        | Plotly Figure. |
